2. Undefined names "verify" and "cert" in the same section of code

1. Update the AsyncHTTPTransport class to accept verify and cert parameters, or
2. Fix the client code to properly pass these parameters according to the transport's definition.

Looking at the error logs, the more straightforward solution would be to fix the client code since the errors suggest the transport class doesn't expect these parameters.
